name: Thomasville
seo_title: Christmas Events for Kids in Thomasville, NC 2026
seo_desc: Christmas events for kids in Thomasville, North Carolina for 2026: a downtown parade, a Denton train and lights, Grinch at Finch in Lexington, with dates checked.
lede: Thomasville's historic downtown hosts a Christmas parade, and nearby Denton runs a country Christmas train while Lexington brings the Grinch to Finch Park.
celebrates: The Thomasville Tourism Commission lists the Thomasville Christmas Parade through historic downtown on Saturday, December 12 at 11 am. Nearby in Davidson County, Denton FarmPark runs the Country Christmas Train on 21 nights from November 27 to December 23, and the Town of Denton hosts Hometown Christmas at Harrison Park on December 4 with a tree lighting and carriage rides. Lexington Parks and Recreation offers Grinch at Finch at Finch Park on December 5.
lastyear: We did not find a published 2025 recap for Thomasville's holiday events. Denton FarmPark's train page says the Christmas Train started in 2008 when the Loflin Family wanted to share the meaning of Christmas with the community.
facts: Denton FarmPark's Christmas Train uses a 1.5 mile track, called the Handy Dandy Railroad, past lights, a live nativity and dancing elves. Tickets bought on i-Tickets are good for any day of the 2026 season, according to the park. Grinch at Finch is at Finch Park, 15 Paul Beck Road, Lexington.
trains: The Country Christmas Train at Denton FarmPark is the nearest Christmas train to Thomasville, with a diesel engine pulling riders around a 1.5 mile lighted track. The N.C. Transportation Museum at the old Spencer Shops in Spencer, listed on our museum guide, has admission from $10 or $20 with a 25 minute train ride.
train_links: The old Spencer Shops with train rides and Christmas train tips, listed on our museum guide.
traditions: Country Christmas Train at Denton FarmPark
A train ride, a lighted village and a petting zoo on 21 nights through December 23.
A free downtown parade on December 12 at 11 am.
A tree lighting, Love Lights Service and carriage rides at Harrison Park on December 4.
A Saturday morning family photo event at Finch Park in Lexington.
kidfact: Denton's Christmas train has a Santa depot and a ride past dancing elves.
faq: When is the Thomasville Christmas Parade?
The Thomasville Tourism Commission lists the parade on Saturday, December 12, 2026 at 11 am in historic downtown Thomasville. Public parades are free to watch.
How much is the Denton Country Christmas Train?
Adults pay $25, seniors and military $20 and children 5 to 17 pay $10. Ages 4 and under are free. Thursdays and Sundays are $15 for adults and $5 for children at the gate, according to the park.
At Finch Park, 15 Paul Beck Road, Lexington, on Saturday, December 5 from 9 to 11 am, according to the City of Lexington calendar.
Should I bring cash to the Denton train?
Yes. The park says its card readers do not always work and asks visitors to be ready to pay cash. Santa photos are cash only.
note: Lexington and Denton fold into this page.
intro_html:
Rally the corgi has sniffed out the best Christmas events for kids in Thomasville for 2026, and here is what he found: 4 family events, at least 1 of them free. The magic runs from November 27 (the Country Christmas Train at Denton FarmPark) through December 23, with Hometown Christmas in Denton (December 4), Grinch at Finch (December 5) and the Thomasville Christmas Parade (December 12) along the way. We check every date on the host's own website, and each listing links straight there.
